record.name: Canadian CT Head Rule

high_risk.name: GCS score < 15 at 2 hours after injury
Suspected open or depressed skull fracture
Any sign of basal skull fracture (hemotympanum, raccoon eyes, otorrhea/rhinorrhea, Battle's sign)

medium_risk.name: Retrograde amnesia to the event >= 30 minutes
Dangerous mechanism (pedestrian struck, occupant ejected, fall from height > 3 feet or 5 stairs)

record.interpretation: High-risk factors indicate CT head is required to identify a neurological intervention risk. Medium-risk factors indicate CT head is required to identify a brain lesion risk.
